title.narrative: Strengthening Social Protection Delivery System in Sindh

description.narrative: Strengthen social protection service delivery system and enhance accessibility and utilization of Mother and Child Health Services in selected districts in Sindh

The development objective of the Strengthening Social Protection Delivery System in Sindh Project for Pakistan is to strengthen social protection service delivery system and enhance accessibility and utilization of mother and child health services in selected districts in Sind. The project comprises of three components. The first component, strengthen Sindh social protection service delivery systems will support the social protection authority (SPA) to build a broader integrated information system for social protection (IIS) to improve the flow of information across social programs and the management of social programs information leading to the implementation of more inclusive and responsive social protection initiatives in Sindh. The second component, mother, and child support program (MCSP) objectives are to create demand for maternal, newborn, and child healthcare (MNCH) and nutrition services and promote behavioral change to increase uptake of the MNCH services focusing on the first 1,000 days of life through the provision of conditional cash transfer (CCTs) in selected districts. The third component, contingent emergency response with zero allocation, will be available to the Borrower to gain quick access to Bank financing to respond to a crisis or emergency.

condition.narrative: Section I, A.2(a) of the Schedule of Project Agreement: the Project Implementing Entity shall establish by no later than three (3)months after the Effective Date, and thereafter maintain throughout the period of implementation of the Project, a Project SteeringCommittee (PSC) headed by the Chairman of the Planning and Development Board of the Project Implementing Entity and comprised of,inter alia, a member nominated by the SPA Board, CEO of SPA, the Secretaries of Finance, Health and Social Protection, of theProject Implementing Entity, as well as representative of health services administration, head of social mobilization partner andtwo (2) members from NGOs active in social protection; which committee shall be responsible for the approval of annualworkplans/budgets for the Project, provision of approvals and policy guidance on any emerging operational issues; oversight of theProject through progress reviews of at least once in six (6) months, but more often if needed; guidance for remedial actions forimproved performance and any budgetary or operational revision in the Project; as well as approval of the Project Operations Manualand its modification.

Section I, A.2(b) of the Schedule of Project Agreement: the Project Implementing Entity shall establish by no later than three (3)months after the Effective Date, and thereafter maintain throughout the period of implementation of the Project, a ProjectCoordination Committee headed by the CEO of SPA and comprised of a designated program manager of the Project, section heads of theSPA and the representative of health services administrator assigned specifically to the Project; which committee shall meet atleast once every month, but more often if needed, discuss progress on quarterly work plans (based on the Annual Work Plan),streamline headquarter and field coordination issues, review progress, identify impediments and initiate corrective actions; aswell as review and approve the modifications that are within the competence of a principal accounting officer.

Section I, A.2(c) of the Schedule of Project Agreement: the Project Implementing Entity shall maintain within SPA throughout theperiod of implementation of the Project, the Project Management Unit (the “PMU”) staffed with competent personnel in adequatenumbers and with qualification, experience and terms of reference satisfactory to the Association, including experts in, interalia, program management, procurement, financial management, environmental and social issues and monitoring and evaluation, whichunit shall be granted the functions, decision-making powers and sufficient resources, as agreed with the Association, for thecarrying out of the Project by SPA.

Section I, C.2(a) of the Schedule of Project Agreement: The Project Implementing Entity shall, prior to the commencement of theConditional Cash Transfers in any of the Selected Districts, engage one or more Payment Agencies, with terms of reference,qualifications and experience satisfactory to the Association, to assist the Project Implementing Entity in administeringConditional Cash Transfers under the MCSP in the Selected Districts.

Section I, D of the Schedule of Project Agreement: The Project Implementing Entity shall ensure to establish by not later thansixty (60) days after the Effective Date, and thereafter maintain throughout the period of Project implementation, a grievanceredress cell and grievance processing protocols for the handling of any stakeholder complaints arising out of the implementation ofthe Project, all in a manner and substance satisfactory to the Association.

Section I, E of the Schedule of Project Agreement: The Project Implementing Entity shall ensure that the collection, use andprocessing (including transfers to third parties) of any Personal Data collected under the Project shall be one in accordance withthe national law and the best international practice, and ensure legitimate, appropriate, and proportionate treatment of such data.
